Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical error in the very first step by failing to identify that "James A. Donohoe" refers to a specific, well-known historical figure (James A. Donohoe, the American politician and author who died in 1914) rather than treating him as a generic name requiring modern obituary searches. Consequently, the Planner instructed the WebSurfer to search for "obituaries" and "death dates" using queries like "James A. Donohoe obituary," which yielded results for modern individuals (dying in 2013/2018) instead of the historical figure. This fundamental misidentification of the subject led the entire search strategy down the wrong path, causing the team to miss the fact that both Madame Pasca and James A. Donohoe died around the same time (1914), and incorrectly assuming James A. Donohoe died much later (2013).
